---
title: "Rounak's Animint Gallery"
author: "Rounak Das"
date: "2026-03-21"
output: html_document
---

```{r render_gallery_table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
meta_file <- "meta.csv"

if (file.exists(meta_file)) {
  meta_df <- read.csv(meta_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Split "user/repo" into two separate columns
  owner_repo_parts <- strsplit(meta_df$viz_owner_repo, "/")
  meta_df$user <- sapply(owner_repo_parts, "[", 1)
  meta_df$repo <- sapply(owner_repo_parts, "[", 2)
  
  # 1. viz.link: Screenshot (Capture.PNG) linking to the animint page
  meta_df$viz.link <- with(meta_df, paste0(
    '<a href="https://', user, '.github.io/', repo, '/">',
    '<img src="https://', user, '.github.io/', repo, '/Capture.PNG" width="200" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:4px; padding:5px;" alt="Screenshot of ', title, '">',
    '</a>'
  ))
  
  # 2. links: GitHub repo and source code
  meta_df$links <- with(meta_df, {
    repo_link <- paste0('<a href="[https://github.com/](https://github.com/)', user, '/', repo, '">Repo</a>')
    source_link <- paste0('<a href="', source, '">Source</a>')
    
    # Check for video column
    video_link <- ""
    if ("video" %in% names(meta_df)) {
       video_link <- ifelse(!is.na(video) & video != "", 
                            paste0(' | <a href="', video, '">Video</a>'), 
                            "")
    }
    
    paste0(repo_link, " | ", source_link, video_link)
  })

  # Organizing columns
  display_df <- meta_df[, c("viz.link", "title", "links")]
  colnames(display_df) <- c("Gallery Link", "Title", "Project Links")

  # Render table
  knitr::kable(display_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-hover"')
  
} else {
  cat("\n\n> **Note:** The `meta.csv` file was not found.")
}
```
